information: ## This is the FMC-Only competition of [Rubik's UK Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023) #### As FMC is not being held at [Rubik's UK Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023), this is your chance to become the UK's Fewest Moves Champion! The podiummers will be crowned during the awards ceremony the following week in Coventry* Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue. *\\* You do not need to attend UKC to become the UK FMC National Champion.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdTFMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f1c5da360c8b31dca76c936b190fcafdeade5f1e/RGB_RUBIK_S_MASTER_LOGO_FILE-_1_-_2_.png)
